senses.gloss: ch. same, to be lax, weak, unsteady.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 65a:18">Kidd. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>אין ולא ורַפְיָא בידיה</he> (he said) yes and no, and it was undecided in his hand; <cite ref="Shabbat 113a">Sabb. 113ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 116a">116ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 14b">B. Mets. 14ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 32a:1">Gitt. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>שופתא … רפיא</he> the pin of the hoe gets loose (from the heat); <he>סיכתא בדפנא ר׳</he> the pin in the wall gets loose; <he>קניא … ר׳</he> the reed in the basket becomes soft again (as if sprouting).

<cite ref="Pesachim 42b:13">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>דרְפָא מקמיט ליה</he> (Ms. M. <he>דרָפֵי</he>; Rashi <he>דרפו</he>, corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="S01461"><he>קְמַט</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 110a">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:11">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="P00306"><he>עוּנְקְתָא</he></cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Nedarim 41b:9">Ned. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>דקא מְרַפֵּי וכ׳</he> he loosens the soil for him (by ploughing near him whom he has vowed not to benefit).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 95b:8">B. Mets. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>מרפי ואזיל קמה</he> (Ms. F. <he>קמא קמא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8; Ar. <he>מְרַפֵּישׂ</he>, <he>מְרַפֵּשׂ</he>) he breaks the ground as he goes before him (that ploughs with his cow).

senses.gloss: to let loose, let go, let alone.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 4:26">Targ. Y. II, Ex. IV, 26</cite> (h. text <he>וירף</he>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 4:13">Targ. Prov. IV, 13</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="V01045"><he>תִרְפֵּא</he></cite>, read: <he>תַ׳</he>).—Y. Ber. VII, 11ᶜ <he>אַרְפּוּנֵיה</he> let him alone. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ <he>אַרְפּוּנוּן ורחמיו וכ׳</he> let them (the mice in their nest) undisturbed, it is written, ‘and his mercies are over all his creatures’ (<cite ref="Psalms 145:9">Ps. CXLV, 9</cite>); Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:6">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>אַרְפּוּן להון</he> leave them (the dogs) alone; a. e.

senses.gloss: to act as a laxative. Pes. l. c. מַרְפֵּא ליה (not להו; Ms. M. מַרְפֵּי; Rashi מרפו, corr. acc.); Sabb. l. c. מרפי, v. קְמַט.

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 18:9">Targ. Prov. XVIII, 9</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>מִתְרַפֵּה</he>).

senses.gloss: to relax, to let one’s hands drop (in astonishment). Targ.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 29:9">Targ. Is. XXIX, 9</cite>.
